newsitem.title: UK: ScotMedia value Grampian at 105 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: ScotMedia value Grampian at 105 mln stg.

text.p: Scottish Media Group Plc announced on Tuesday it had agreed with Grampian Television Plc to buy it at price, which valued the company at about 320 pence a share valuing whole of Grampian at about 105.4 million pounds ($172.3 million).
Scottish Media will offer 18.3425 new Scottish Media shares and 192 pounds of new Scottish Media convertible unsecured loan stock for every 100 Grampian shares, it said.
There will also be a full cash alternative to the offer of 320 pence for each Grampian share. The cash will be provided from Scottish Media's own resources and a revolving credit facility.

The offer price represents a premium of 22 percent over the mid-market closing price of Grampian of 262.5 pence on May 30, 1997, the day prior to the announcement that the companies were in merger talks.

The merger with Grampian is expected to be earnings neutral for Scottish Media in the current financial year and earnings enhancing in the first complete financial year following the acquisition, the companies said.
